calls.title: Greg / Christian
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the next steps for a partnership with Legends, confirming the onboarding and training to prepare for a pilot involving GrowthBook's experimentation capabilities. Plans were made for a pilot focused on creating automated microsites for live soccer events tied to FIFA, emphasizing A/B testing capabilities. Ongoing support from Legends was deemed crucial for customer service during this phase. Gregory articulated a long-term vision for establishing a testing center of excellence by 2027, aiming to optimize experimentation. Concerns from Johan were successfully addressed, allowing for smoother pilot execution and facilitating creative experimentation strategies around microsites, marketing channels, and fan engagement expansions.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, experimentation, FIFA microsites, onboarding, pilot testing, soccer fan engagement
